summary: Pool node pop-or-alloc over a global container read via GlobalDataRead. Tries to pop the free-list head: saves its value, clears the in-use flag byte, and unlinks it with LinkedListNodeRemovalByValue; if the removal fails the node is not reused. When nothing is popped, allocates a node struct (4 bytes) and a data block (68 bytes), initializes four DWORDs of the block via ThunkToFUN00491330, appends the node to a doubly linked list, and clears 64 bytes of it with sub_4BB490. Then runs a dealloc-walk that searches the list for a node matching the head's value, unlinks it, decrements the list count, and destroys/frees it via sub_491E40 and FreeWrapper_7bcf. Ends by running ShortComputation_16e0 over the four inputs and returns the resulting node pointer (or 0).

local_names.v4: global container struct returned by GlobalDataRead (list header at v4+4)
local_names.v6: list struct pointer aliasing v4+4 (head +0, tail +4, next +8, count +12)
local_names.v21: value read from the popped free-list head
local_names.v16: value of the node found by the dealloc-walk
local_names.v7: result node pointer returned to the caller

operations.description: GlobalDataRead() returns the global container whose sub-structure holds the pool list.
Record free-list head v4[4], save container, mirror head into list slot v6[2], and clear result v7 to 0.
Pop path only runs while the free-list head v4[4] is non-null.
LinkedListNodeRemovalByValue(head value, 1) attempts to unlink the head node; the byte at node+8 is cleared first, and on a zero return the reuse is abandoned (v7 = 0).
Alloc path runs when no node was successfully popped (v7 == 0).

OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(4) allocates the node struct; OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(68) allocates its data block; failure of the first yields a null node, failure of the second nulls the node's payload pointer.
do-while over 4 iterations calling ThunkToFUN00491330 to initialize the four DWORDs of the data block.
DoublyLinkedListAppend(container, node, 1) appends the freshly allocated node to the pool list.
for i in 0..63 step 16, sub_4BB490(i + node, 0) clears a 64-byte region inside the node.

Dealloc-walk: start from the list tail slot v6[2] (mirrored head), iterate nodes by their +4 next pointer searching for a node whose value equals the head value; guard requires the head value and list to be non-null.

Unlink the matched node: fix predecessor's +4 next (or list head), fix tail slot v6[2] when the tail is removed, fix tail pointer v6[1] when removing the last node, and decrement the list count v6[3].
sub_491E40(node) runs the node destructor, then FreeWrapper_7bcf(node) releases its heap memory.
ShortComputation_16e0(a1, a2, a3, a4) runs over the four input parameters after the pop/alloc/dealloc logic.
Return the result node pointer v7 (0 when the pop failed and no node was returned). Called by the collision broadphase builder, rectangle clipping, proxy-list builder and related collision helpers.
